title: eruca loncholoma
intro: Eruca loncholoma, commonly known as the desert rocket, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, offering several health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Eruca loncholoma include anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular protective effects, attributed to its ability to modulate various biochemical pathways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
